observed_process: Goods are received, scanned, checked, and routed for stowing.
data_signals: barcode scan, arrival time, supplier data, exception notes
possible_agentic_use_case: Inbound exception triage assistant that summarises likely causes and routes to the right staff member.

observed_process: Items are placed into storage locations with scan confirmation.
data_signals: item ID, tote ID, pod/location, scan success, mismatch flag
possible_agentic_use_case: Stow guidance assistant that explains mismatch errors and suggests next safe steps.
human_review_needed: Yes, for repeated mismatch or safety concern.

observed_process: Pick tasks are allocated and completed with scanning.
data_signals: order priority, pick time, item location, error flags
possible_agentic_use_case: Pick-support agent that answers procedural questions and flags abnormal delays.
human_review_needed: No for basic guidance; yes for disciplinary or safety decisions.

observed_process: Orders are checked, packed, labelled, and sent to shipping.
data_signals: weight, dimensions, packaging type, damage flag
possible_agentic_use_case: Packaging recommendation agent that suggests materials and asks for confirmation if a fragile/damaged item is detected.

observed_process: Staff and automation operate under marked zones and safety procedures.
data_signals: near-miss reports, training status, zone alerts
possible_agentic_use_case: Safety briefing assistant that generates role-specific reminders from approved policy.

observed_process: Quality checks identify mis-picks, missing items, or damaged goods.
data_signals: defect type, image note, operator note, resolution
possible_agentic_use_case: Quality-review agent that clusters defects and drafts improvement suggestions.
